name: campusconnect-iso25010
description: Raccourcis de démarrage (start.bat / stop.bat, configurations IntelliJ du dossier .run) et outils QA ISO 25010 exécutables par npm.

scripts.qa:newman: newman run qa/newman/campusconnect.postman_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=%BACKEND_URL% -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export qa/reports/newman/index.html --reporter-junit-export qa/reports/newman/junit.xml
scripts.qa:newman:local: newman run qa/newman/campusconnect.postman_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:8280 -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export qa/reports/newman/index.html --reporter-junit-export qa/reports/newman/junit.xml
scripts.qa:newman:docker: newman run qa/newman/campusconnect.postman_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:8380 -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export qa/reports/newman-docker/index.html --reporter-junit-export qa/reports/newman-docker/junit.xml
